frames.uniformity: one EXIF tuple across all 310 frames (exiftool sweep of exposure|iso|model|lens|focal|size|compression)

process.rejection: winsorized sigma clipping low=3 high=3 (pinned master doctrine)
process.bitdepth_why: 32-bit float output: the 310-frame mean carries sub-ADU structure (stat sigma 0.6, MAD 0.3 ADU) that a 16-bit integer master would quantize away

output.sanity: mean == median == the Nikon 14-bit pedestal (~1008 ADU); uniform, tight FPN spread; rejection touched only outlier pixels

provenance.raw_darks: deleted after the build on user order; re-stageable from the user's archive
provenance.match_check_pending: lights must match 1/2500 | ISO 800 | 70 mm | Lossless NEF; verify with an exiftool sweep at lights arrival BEFORE calibrate
